    req_fail = set(case['required_failure_items'])
    unres_without = set(case['unresolved_without'])

            complement = [x for x in cur if x not in subset]
            if test(complement) == 'FAIL':
                cur = complement
                n = 2
                reduced = True
                break

            continue

        if n >= len(cur):

        'outcome': 'FAIL',
        'tests': tests_count

    avg = len(lst) // n
    rem = len(lst) % n
    result = []
    idx = 0
    for i in range(n):

        result.append(lst[idx:idx+sz])
        idx += sz
